children: Equity Bancshares' net interest margin compressed to 4.20% in 3Q from 4.36% the prior quarter as deposit pricing pressures outpaced gains in interest income. Net interest income fell $1 million quarter over quarter to $72.8 million, even as interest income grew $1.1 million. The expansion in cost of funds, driven by competition for rate-sensitive time and municipal deposits, weighed on results. Average earning assets rose $78 million during the period, largely from investment balances funded by borrowings, which further pressured margins.
